chunks: And Noah, when he called before this, so We heard him and saved him and his family from the great distress;
ai.seo_question: How did God respond to Noah's call during the flood?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the efficacy of persistent supplication (dua) during times of tribulation, illustrating how divine response often follows a period of testing. The 'great distress' is traditionally understood as the flood, from which Noah and the believers were saved, while the disbelievers perished, emphasizing the theme of divine deliverance for the steadfast.
